name: Qur'an Majeed — 13 line, Indo-Pak
licence: Freely available online; cleared for use in this app by Taiyabah Masjid
prepared: 30-juz PDF set rendered at 150dpi, trimmed to the union of ink across all 848 pages so no page loses content, saved as lossless grayscale WebP

geometry.note: Geometry for reading sideways, measured off the pages themselves. left and right bound the block of writing — outside them is the printed frame and its margin, which a sideways window crops so the lines reach both edges of the screen. Each page entry is [frameTop, frameBottom, ...rows the printing left blank between one line and the next], and null means a page with no lines to divide, shown whole.
